descriptionChirho: The proper noun Yaḥăzîʾēl (יַחֲזִיאֵל), meaning 'God sees' or 'God will behold,' used for several individuals: (1) a Levite in the time of Jehoshaphat who prophesied victory (2 Chr 20:14), (2) a chief who joined David at Ziklag (1 Chr 12:5), (3) a priest who blew the trumpet before the ark (1 Chr 16:6), (4) a Levite, son of Hebron (1 Chr 23:19; 24:23), and (5) a returnee from exile (Ezra 8:5). English renders 'Jahaziel' and 'Yachaziel'; Spanish 'Yajaziel/Yaḥaziel/Jahaziel'; Arabic يَحْزِيئِيلُ/يَحَزِيئِيل (Yaḥzīʾīl); Korean 야하지엘/야하시엘 (Yahajiel); Swahili 'Yahazieli'; Hindi यहजीएल/यखज़ीएल. The two clusters differ only in the presence or absence of the conjunction waw (and-Jahaziel vs. Jahaziel), which is a grammatical inflection, not a semantic distinction.
